svg.text: Shared-memory banks: why padding helps a column access, and why tiled doesn't need it
Drawn with 8 banks and an 8-wide tile for legibility; the T4 has 32 banks and the pattern is the same at 32 × 32.
Cost of +1: rows are no longer 16-byte aligned, so 4 neighbouring floats can't be read with one 128-bit load (LDS.128). regtile / vec pad by 4 instead.
